proposals.evidence: Turner distinguishes the retained-velar *nakkha branch from simple nakha with lost intervocalic k: explicit comparanda include Bashkarik nakh, Torwali nōkh and western Pahari nekhər/nègər. These survey nakh/nokh forms and western diminutives retain that diagnostic velar; the eastern forms are qualified members of the same retained-velar family, without excluding learned reinforcement. Nasal nāṅg-type compounds and Persian nākhun are excluded.
